raw_record.question_text:
As shown in the figure, an insulating inclined plane with an angle of $\theta$ is fixed in a uniform electric field. The direction of the electric field is horizontal to the right, and the magnitude of the electric field strength is $E$. An object with mass $m$ and charge $+q$ is given an initial velocity $v_{0}$ from point $A$ and slides up the inclined plane, just managing to move along the plane at a constant speed.

1. Find the coefficient of kinetic friction between the object and the inclined plane.

method.method_draft: Use Newton's second law resolved parallel and perpendicular to the inclined plane. First read from the image that the ramp rises from A toward B at angle θ above the horizontal, the electric-field arrows point horizontally to the right, and the block's initial velocity is up the plane, so kinetic friction acts down the plane. From the text, use that the charge is +q, so the electric force is qE to the right, and that the block moves at constant speed, so acceleration along the plane is zero. Resolve forces: along the plane, electric force contributes qE cosθ upward, gravity contributes mg sinθ downward, and friction μN downward. Perpendicular to the plane, the normal force must balance both the inward component of gravity mg cosθ and the inward component of the electric force qE sinθ, giving N = mg cosθ + qE sinθ. Then impose qE cosθ - mg sinθ - μN = 0 and solve for μ.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中斜面从左下方的 A 点向右上方的 B 点升高，斜面与水平面的夹角标为 \(\theta\)。多条水平箭头指向右方，表示匀强电场方向向右，旁边标有 \(E\)。物块在斜面上，速度箭头 \(v_0\) 沿斜面向上，即从 A 向 B 运动。

推理：物块带正电 \(+q\)，所以电场力大小为 \(qE\)，方向水平向右。取沿斜面向上为正方向。电场力沿斜面方向的分量为 \(qE\cos\theta\)，方向沿斜面向上；重力沿斜面方向的分量为 \(mg\sin\theta\)，方向沿斜面向下。物块正在沿斜面向上运动，因此动摩擦力方向沿斜面向下，大小为 \(\mu N\)。因为物块匀速运动，沿斜面方向加速度为零，所以有 \(qE\cos\theta-mg\sin\theta-\mu N=0\)。

再看垂直斜面方向：重力压向斜面的分量为 \(mg\cos\theta\)；水平向右的电场力也有压向斜面的分量 \(qE\sin\theta\)。因此支持力大小为 \(N=mg\cos\theta+qE\sin\theta\)。代入沿斜面平衡方程，得到 \(\mu=\frac{qE\cos\theta-mg\sin\theta}{mg\cos\theta+qE\sin\theta}\)。

method.method_draft: Use a work-energy balance over an arbitrary displacement s up the incline, combined with a normal-force calculation. From the image, read that moving up the plane makes a horizontal displacement s cosθ to the right and a vertical rise s sinθ, while the electric field is horizontal to the right. From the text, the charge is positive, so the electric field does positive work qE s cosθ; the motion is constant speed, so ΔK = 0. Gravity does negative work -mg s sinθ, friction does negative work -μNs, and the normal force does no work. Determine N from perpendicular force balance using the geometry in the image: both gravity and the rightward electric force press the block into the plane, so N = mg cosθ + qE sinθ. Then set total work to zero: qE s cosθ - mg s sinθ - μNs = 0, cancel s, and solve for μ.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中斜面从左下方 A 点向右上方 B 点倾斜，斜面与水平面的夹角标为 \theta；物块在斜面上，从 A 点沿斜面向右上方运动，初速度方向标为 v_0；均匀电场用多条水平向右的箭头表示，旁边标有 E。若物块沿斜面向上位移 s，则由图中几何关系可知，水平位移为 s\cos\theta，竖直升高为 s\sin\theta。

推理：物块带正电 +q，所以电场力 qE 水平向右。沿斜面向上运动时，电场力做正功 W_E=qE\,s\cos\theta；重力做负功 W_g=-mg\,s\sin\theta；摩擦力方向沿斜面向下，做功 W_f=-\mu Ns；支持力不做功。物块恰能匀速运动，所以动能变化 \Delta K=0，总功为零。

先求支持力 N。垂直斜面方向上没有加速度。重力压向斜面的分量为 mg\cos\theta；水平向右的电场力也有压向斜面的分量 qE\sin\theta。因此 N=mg\cos\theta+qE\sin\theta。

由功的关系：qE\,s\cos\theta-mg\,s\sin\theta-\mu Ns=0。代入 N 并消去 s，得 qE\cos\theta-mg\sin\theta-\mu(mg\cos\theta+qE\sin\theta)=0。因此 \mu=\frac{qE\cos\theta-mg\sin\theta}{mg\cos\theta+qE\sin\theta}。
